Found by Mikolaj's browser check of 0.1 on 2026-10-21; the game driver and the page gate missed it, pressing their keys while the game played itself and its timers kept the scheduler running, and both now press Escape on a quiet screen. Watched again on 2026-10-21 with rts_scheduleWork deleted from syncExport, where the fix has lived since: ts-src/run-wasm-game.mjs fails with `lhKey([object Object]) repainted nothing within 5s`. tools/check-sync-exports.py requires syncExport of every sync export. A tier-1 record, no commit carrying the bug to replay.
